description.value: Haultain Fish & Chips has been a Victoria institution since 1924, serving fresh seafood — halibut, cod, prawns, oysters, scallops, and calamari — fried or grilled with housemade coleslaw and tartar sauce. Tucked into a residential neighbourhood about five minutes from downtown Victoria, it draws both tourists and locals to a classic neighbourhood chippy with a full eat-in dining room. Street parking is available directly in front of the building.
